item.title: Operation ‘Thrashy’ Major Breakthrough; Terror Networks To Be Crushed: LoP Sunil Sharma
item.description: Jammu, Feb 19: Leader of Opposition Sunil Sharma on Thursday termed “Operation Thrashy” a significant breakthrough by security forces, asserting that intensified operations will soon yield further success against militants operating in parts of Jammu region. Speaking to reporters, Sharma said that for a long time security forces were engaged in frequent encounters and exchanges of fire without achieving major success, but the recent breakthrough has “opened a new gate” in anti-terror operations.
